title: Rewind of the Suffix Tape
statement: Let $w,s,v$ be Boolean words, let $o$ be a bit, and let $p$ be an input-head position for $w$. For every natural number $j\le |v|$, starting in phase $5$ with $s$ on the first two tapes, $v$ on the third tape, the first two work heads at the origin, and the suffix head at displacement $j-1$, the preparation machine reaches phase $6$ after exactly $j+1$ steps with the suffix head at the origin, preserving the words, flag, and input-head position.
replaced:
Let $j$ be at most the length of the suffix word. From the preparation
machine's suffix-rewind phase with the suffix head at displacement $j - 1$,
exactly $j+1$ steps yield the frame of the next phase with the suffix head at
the origin; all three words are preserved.
